title: アグネスタキオン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the purpose of understanding the latent potential of the Umamusume body and its limits, Agnes Tachyon spends much of her time conducting research in the pursuit of speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Through the Twinkle Series, our days together in search of the limits of Umamusume potential begin.
